description: Demand gen programmes and what they actually produced. The funnel columns are computed from leads and opportunities, not reported by the channel — so the numbers say what happened rather than what was promised.

columns.name: source_value
columns.note: The value this campaign writes into the lead/opportunity source field. THE JOIN KEY — attribution silently returns zero without it.

columns.name: crm_campaign_id
columns.note: CRM campaign record id, where the org uses campaign objects

columns.name: offer
columns.note: What the prospect actually got: report, demo, trial, meeting

columns.name: leads_created
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: leads_contactable
columns.note: DERIVED. A purchased list that is 60% unmailable cost more than it looks.

columns.name: leads_worked
columns.note: DERIVED: leads that got past New. Untouched leads are a routing problem, not a channel problem — separating them stops the wrong lever being pulled.

columns.name: leads_qualified
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: opps_created
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: pipeline_created
columns.note: DERIVED: sum of opportunity amount

columns.name: closed_won
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: revenue_won
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: closed_lost
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: still_open
columns.note: DERIVED. Judging a campaign before its deals resolve is the most common attribution error.

columns.name: lead_to_opp_rate
columns.note: DERIVED %. Blank when the sample is too small to mean anything.

columns.name: cost_per_lead
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: cost_per_opp
columns.note: DERIVED

columns.name: pipeline_roi
columns.note: DERIVED: pipeline_created / spend. A ratio, not a percentage.

columns.name: days_to_first_opp
columns.note: DERIVED: median. Tells you when a campaign can fairly be judged.

columns.name: maturity
columns.note: DERIVED: whether enough of the cohort has resolved to draw a conclusion. Guards against judging a long-cycle campaign at week three.

columns.name: sample_note
columns.note: DERIVED. Plain language on what the numbers can and cannot support.
